name: openrouter-insights
description: Display OpenRouter API pricing and track your OpenRouter account usage in VS Code

commands.title: Select API Key for Usage View

openrouterInsights.statusBar.show.description: Show pricing information in the VS Code status bar.

openrouterInsights.statusBar.maxWidth.description: Maximum characters for the model name in the status bar. Set to 0 to let the status bar expand dynamically (VS Code will add its own ellipsis on overflow).

enumDescriptions: Open the model browser on click
Show a quick-actions context menu on click
openrouterInsights.statusBar.clickAction.description: What happens when the status bar item is clicked.

openrouterInsights.modelBrowser.showFree.description: Only show free models in the model browser and status bar.

enumDescriptions: Sort by estimated blended rate (cheapest first)
Sort by prompt price per 1M tokens
Sort by completion price per 1M tokens
Sort by context window length (largest first)
openrouterInsights.modelBrowser.sort.description: Default sort order for the model browser.

openrouterInsights.modelBrowser.favorite.description: List of OpenRouter model IDs to pin to the top of the model browser (e.g. ["openai/gpt-4o", "anthropic/claude-sonnet"]).

openrouterInsights.modelBrowser.showDepr.description: Show deprecated/legacy models in the model browser. Disable to hide them.

openrouterInsights.general.selectedModel.description: Manually override the tracked model ID (e.g. "openai/gpt-4o"). Leave empty to auto-detect from Copilot's active model.

prompt.description: Prompt percentage used in blended pricing.

completion.description: Completion percentage used in blended pricing.

cacheRead.description: Cache-read percentage used when a model supports cache pricing.

cacheWrite.description: Cache-write percentage used when a model supports cache-write pricing.

openrouterInsights.general.blendWeights.description: Blend weights for blended pricing estimate. All four weights must total 100%.

enumDescriptions: Only show pricing when an OpenRouter BYOK model is selected
Show pricing for any model provider (Copilot, OpenRouter, etc.)
openrouterInsights.general.providerScope.description: Which model providers to detect and show pricing for.

enumDescriptions: Log all messages including debug-level detail
openrouterInsights.general.logLevel.description: Verbosity level for the OpenRouter Insights output channel.

openrouterInsights.general.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenRouter models API. Change this to use a self-hosted proxy or custom enterprise endpoint.

openrouterInsights.general.autoRefreshIn.description: Auto-refresh interval in seconds (min 0, max 86400). Set to 0 to disable auto-refresh.

openrouterInsights.general.modelPollInte.description: How often (in seconds) to poll for model changes. Set to 0 to disable polling (rely on file watcher only). Default: 30.

openrouterInsights.features.statusBar.en.description: Show pricing in the VS Code status bar.

openrouterInsights.features.modelBrowser.description: Enable the QuickPick model browser and switcher commands.

openrouterInsights.features.comparison.e.description: Enable the side-by-side model comparison webview.

openrouterInsights.features.export.enabl.description: Enable CSV and JSON export commands.

openrouterInsights.features.hoverProvide.description: Show pricing tooltips when hovering over OpenRouter model IDs (e.g. 'openai/gpt-4o') in source files.

openrouterInsights.statusBar.template.description: Template for the status bar text. Variables: ${modelName}, ${priceText} (compact blended rate), ${blendedRate}, ${promptPrice}, ${completionPrice}, ${contextLength}, ${deprecation} (warning icon when deprecated). Use ${promptPrice} and ${completionPrice} for detailed pricing.

openrouterInsights.general.currency.description: Currency for pricing display. Rates are static estimates. Set a custom rate via openrouterInsights.general.currencyRate for precision.

openrouterInsights.general.currencyRate.description: Override the exchange rate for the selected currency (USD → target). Set to 0 to use the built-in static rate. Example: 0.92 for EUR.

openrouterInsights.general.cacheTtlHours.description: Cache time-to-live in hours before pricing is considered stale (1–720). Default: 24.

openrouterInsights.features.usage.enable.description: Enable OpenRouter account usage tracking (balance, credits, budget limits).

openrouterInsights.usage.autoRefreshInte.description: Auto-refresh interval for usage data in seconds (min 0, max 86400). Set to 0 to disable.

openrouterInsights.usage.backgroundPolli.description: Allow background polling of authenticated account usage. Turn off to refresh usage only on demand.

openrouterInsights.usage.analytics.enabl.description: Include analytics enrichment in detailed usage refreshes. Turn off to reduce account-data collection.

openrouterInsights.usage.analytics.lookb.description: Number of days included in opt-in analytics enrichment (1–90).

openrouterInsights.usage.lowBalanceThres.description: Dollar threshold below which the status bar shows a warning (set to 0 to disable warnings).

openrouterInsights.usage.showStatusBar.description: Show account balance in the VS Code status bar.

enumDescriptions: Open the full usage dashboard in an editor tab on click
Open the usage dashboard in the sidebar on click
Show a quick-actions context menu on click
openrouterInsights.usage.statusBarClickA.description: What happens when the usage status bar item is clicked.

openrouterInsights.usage.showDashboard.description: Show the usage dashboard sidebar panel.

scripts.package:verified: node scripts/package-vsix.mjs && node scripts/checksum-vsix.mjs && node scripts/size.mjs --bundle --vsix
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check
